name: list_meetings
description: List upcoming calendar meetings (with their customWhispr note if one exists) and recent recorded meeting notes. Use the returned event_id or note_id with the other tools.

query.description: Optional: filter by title / full-text search

name: get_meeting_prep
description: Get the live-coaching prep for a meeting: checklist (goals, questions to ask, facts, expected objections), stance, attached prep material names, and whether coaching is on.

name: set_meeting_prep
description: Set the live-coaching prep for a meeting (creates the meeting note for an upcoming calendar event if needed) and turn coaching on. REPLACES the existing checklist. Keep 4-14 items, most important first; text <= 12 words, detail <= 30 words (numbers, names, planned responses). The coach tracks these live and suggests them at the right moment.

prep_text.description: Optional full prep doc (markdown) to attach for reference

intensity.description: How often the coach speaks up in this meeting (default: the user's setting). Use active for negotiations or high-stakes calls the user wants to be held to the stance.

name: get_meeting_transcript
description: Get a recorded meeting: title, date, attendees, the speaker-labeled transcript (markdown, '**Name:** text'), the user's own notes and any AI-generated notes.

name: get_coaching_summary
description: Get the result of the last live-coached session for a meeting: prep checklist coverage (covered by whom and when, follow-ups for missed items), talk share, tone verdicts over time, and every suggestion the coach showed with its timestamp.
